lang_en:
I bet her we'd turn back on a Himalayan trek.
Loser does the dishes till March.
She called it an excuse.
I said we drive to the corner shop.
We shook on it. The trek: Brahmatal.
NakshIQ took her side: Brahmatal, easy.
Fitness level: easy.
I said, easy for who?
She led the whole way.
Nobody turned back.
I've been doing the dishes since.
Travel intelligence settles the bet at home.
NakshIQ.
lang_hi:
मैंने उससे शर्त लगाई कि हिमालय के ट्रेक से हम बीच रास्ते लौट आएँगे।
हारने वाला मार्च तक बर्तन धोएगा।
उसने कहा, ये बस बहाना है।
मैंने कहा, हम तो नुक्कड़ की दुकान तक गाड़ी से जाते हैं।
हाथ मिलाया। ट्रेक: ब्रह्मताल।
NakshIQ ने उसका साथ दिया: ब्रह्मताल, आसान।
फ़िटनेस लेवल: आसान।
मैंने कहा, आसान किसके लिए?
पूरे रास्ते वो आगे रही।
कोई नहीं लौटा।
तब से बर्तन मैं ही धो रहा हूँ।
ट्रैवल इंटेलिजेंस, शर्त घर पर ही निपटा देती है।
NakshIQ.

cover.hook: I bet her we'd *turn back* | on a Himalayan trek.

shots: s1: Daytime, a small kitchen. He points at a sink full of dishes; she laughs, arms crossed. (covers lines 1-2)
s2: She jabs a finger at his chest; he shrugs and mimes turning a steering wheel. (covers lines 3-4)
s3: They shake hands over the kitchen counter, both grinning, neither letting go. (covers line 5)
s4: She holds her phone up to his face, screen away from camera, triumphant; he squints and shrugs. (covers lines 6-8)
s5: Daylight on a hiking trail: she walks ahead with trekking poles, glances back and waves him on; he follows, smiling despite himself. (covers lines 9-10)
s6: Back in the kitchen, he stands at the sink washing a plate; she leans on the counter beside him, grinning. (covers lines 11-13)
